blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Sandiganbayan Third Division has raised concern about the inadequacy of closed-circuit television (CCTV) camera surveillance system inside the Bureau of Jail Management and Penology (BJMP) following claims that former House Speaker and Leyte Representative Martin Romualdez could leave the facility. In an eight-page order dated Tuesday, the court noted a Facebook post alleging that the BJMP QC Jail Male Dormitory allows Romualdez to leave his jail cell. The court said that while the author recanted their post, it conducted an ocular inspection of the facility to check its condition, particularly the monitoring system. READ: Court to BJMP: […]...
